title: Great for any Harry Potter fan!
text: Great for any Harry Potter fan!. Got this for a friend for her birthday because she loves all things Harry Potter. It was nice quality & decent price. I recommend to any Harry Potter fan!

product_metadata.title: Harry Potter Ilustrated Hogwart's Crest Grocery Travel Reusable Tote Bag
features: ECO-FRIENDLY: Save the planet one grocery trip at a time with our small reusable tote bag. Going green has never been easier. Tote your farmer's market treasures, and school or office lunch, or use it to hold your personal belongings for a day of errand running.

HIGH QUALITY: Featuring a roomy compartment and open construction, our all-purpose tote was made to carry a bundle. Heavyweight canvas and reinforced shoulder straps ensure you and your tote will enjoy a long and happy life together.

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Our reusable bag showcases the featured design and is crafted from sturdy canvas. The design shown appears on one side. Produced with UV resistant inks to inhibit fading. Bag measures approximately 1.0" x 15.3 x 15.8, with a 9" drop handle length.

OFFICIALLY LICENSED: Harry Potter products sold by Graphics and More are guaranteed authentic, high quality and officially licensed by Warner Bros. Proudly printed in the USA. HARRY POTTER characters, names and related indicia are & WBEI. (s20)
